# Separately bounded real-tool extension

Declared before downloading/building/executing ABC, 2026-10-28. This extends the previous phase's self-imposed no-new-download rule for an independently useful public-netlist/real-tool check, within user-authorized existing CPU/RAM/disk. The frozen 5-arm comparison is unchanged. No change to model selection/training hyperparameters and no test-set-driven retraining.

Try one pinned public ABC source archive (<=30MB) and public EPFL benchmark README/one smallest suitable combinational design (<=2MB). No alternate-source attempt after access denial. Read any repository instructions before compiling. Bound make to2 jobs/10 minutes, no system install, existing16GiB memory/4CPU total, no GPU or paid services. Stay within45min from first main start for the combined experiment. Store URLs/commit hashes, downloaded bytes, compiler logs/errors.

Aim: actually use ABC to map a public input circuit to an explicitly specified open teaching genlib; convert the resulting mapped PM back to AIG; verify equivalence using ABC CEC. Parse cell/pin truth tables explicitly and validate exhaustive functional agreement if PI<=10; otherwise do not enlarge enumeration into a costly run. Apply an already frozen trained paired representation/ranker and the same independently implemented exact ECO solver on a bounded number of known patch sites. Compare ranking baselines, emit real patch netlists, and require independent full I/O equivalence (exhaustive truth table and ideally ABC CEC). No training on the public evaluation circuit.

This can demonstrate real netlist/preprocessing/execution interfaces on a public design, but is not original industrial training data, authors' modified ABC runeco/&nf, a physical timing ECO flow, or original technology-library ADP reproduction. The simple genlib is a documented substitution with invented unit costs, never described as the paper's actual libraries or timing. If an essential public asset is denied or build fails after bounded diagnosis, record the exact identifier/files and stop this extension; do not bypass. Report whether completed or blocked and retain primary controlled comparison independently.

Parser-format correction before extension inference: first preparation successfully mapped and proved CEC, but stopped because current ABC `write_bench` defaults to LUT syntax, whereas the explicit AIG reader expects AND/NOT. Its `write_bench -h` documents `-l` toggles LUT output off. Preserve failed log/source and use `write_bench -l`; no function/library/architecture changes or hand-guessed truth-bit convention. This is an official output-format flag, not an alternate asset or access workaround.
